structure def_cpwl_function (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ) : Prop where
  continuous : Continuous f
  pieces : Type
  finite_pieces : Fintype pieces

completed_predicate:
def def_cpwl_function (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Continuous f ∧
    ∃ pieces : Type, ∃ _ : Fintype pieces, ∃ carrier : pieces → Set (Fin n → ℝ),
      (∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, ∃ P : pieces, x ∈ carrier P)
